content.competency: Comprende y describe algunos detalles en textos cortos y sencillos sobre temas familiares, a partir de imágenes y frases conocidas.
content.example: Felipe lives in Yopal. He is 8 years old. He loves technology, especially he likes to play with his Tablet. The problem is that Felipe spends more than 5 hours playing with his tablet every day. This might be bad for him. Felipe has a problem. He plays with his tablet every day.
misconceptions: creer que la interpretación de un texto es única

content.competency: Responde, de manera oral o escrita, preguntas sencillas sobre textos descriptivos cortos y alusivos a temas conocidos y de clase.
content.example: What is your favorite superhero? A superhero is a person who has special abilities, and helps people in need. There are many examples of superheroes on TV: Iron man, Superman, Wonder Woman, and Captain America. They usually wear a cape and a mask so people don’t know who they are. They have super powers, such as: flying, disappearing, fighting, etc. - What is a superhero? It’s a person who has super powers. - What are some examples of superheroes? Superman, Wonder Woman, Captain America. - What does a superhero do? A superhero helps people in need. - Who is your favorite superhero? Spider-Man.
misconceptions: creer que la interpretación de un texto es única

content.competency: Intercambia ideas y opiniones sencillas con compañeros y profesores, siguiendo modelos o a través de imágenes.
content.example: ['A: Mauro, do you watch TV every day?', 'B: Yes, I watch TV 2 hours every day.', 'A: Rosita, how about you?', 'C: I don’t watch TV. I don’t like it.']

content.competency: Describe, de manera oral y escrita, objetos, lugares, personas y comunidades, usando oraciones simples. Puede, por ejemplo, hablar o escribir sobre su barrio y lo que allí encuentra.
content.example: This is my neighborhood. There is a park, and a church. There are many houses. There are trees, plants, and a small river. The river is dirty because people throw garbage in it.
